chapter_mission: Asteroid training combat sequences; Jacen's precognitive futures clarify; Ben's unease becomes more specific.
chapter_turn: The work becomes visible — Jacen is training in a mode that is not Jedi training, and Ben, even at thirteen, can tell.

scene_plan.purpose: Asteroid combat training — projected Vectivus-echoes as sparring partners; fork-visions as tactical input.

exit_vector: Jacen finishing a sparring sequence against projected Vectivus-echoes; Ben watching and not asking the question forming in him.
notes: The book's most physical chapter in the back half. Rogue-Squadron combat choreography applied to a Force-echo sparring sequence.
